title: Fun family game night(s) but beware the subscription is indefinite
text:
The 6 month season is fun, but a bit pricey. I didn't realize that once you "find the killer" the subscription continues, but it is indeed clearly marked in the description, (or at least now it is, I missed it when ordering initially). It is a fun family game night, but I did cancel once I realized I was getting season two boxes. And in case you're wondering they can't be returned as per Mildred from Hunt A Killer customer service.

"Each investigation unfolds over a six-episode season. You’ll eliminate one suspect every month until the thrilling conclusion. Once you find the killer, your subscription continues with a brand new story!"

Have fun hunting!
label: positive
